In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the citys casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: 哪咤之魔童降世 Ne Zha

programme.title: 冲天火 Sky on Fire
programme.desc: 任职于顶尖秘密医疗设施的保安主任宗天保，在一名年轻窃贼盗取一种突破性新药后，卷入了一场激烈的争斗然而，当他揭开该药物的真正起源后，宗天保必须寻找可靠的盟友来保护这药物，确保它不落入歹徒之手，并阻止一场残酷的争夺战爆发.

programme.title: 72家租客 72 Tenants of Prosperity
programme.desc: 哈公与石坚本为一对结拜兄弟，二人同时爱上小桃红最后，因为小桃红下嫁于哈公，石坚因此怀恨在心，从此在生意上与哈公互不相让，各出其谋斗个你死我活直至四十年后，二人的种种恩怨，最终因为大业主强收物业的问题，而渐渐得到化解.

programme.title: 蛟龙行动 Operation Hadal
programme.desc: 深海特种部队接获紧急任务，协同潜艇龙鲸号深入大洋，阻止国际势力策动的超级潜艇阴谋海底战场险象环生，面对敌方的重重伏击与火山口密布的极限深渊，龙鲸号在生死边缘展开极限周旋在这片无人知晓的幽闭深海，一场关乎全球命运赌上性命的终极决战正式打响.

programme.title: 一样的天空 Look Up
programme.desc: 此片是庆祝香港回归25周年的献礼电影，描述四位不同背景年青港人的故事，包括一名自闭症的青年追寻艺术梦父子两代矛盾如何和好粤剧名伶突破自己协助年轻人发展流行音乐事业一名尼泊尔青年成为醒狮队员的文化共融故事.

programme.title: 临时决斗 Hit N Fun
programme.desc: 澳门拳王钟磊在现实夹缝中苦撑拳馆，坚持培训职业拳手广告总监林雪发现男友外遇对象竟是当红拳击冠军，怒火中烧发出战书，约定擂台一决高下她拜入钟磊门下，投身艰苦训练在汗水与伤痛的洗礼中，林雪逐步蜕变，明白这场战斗，不再为复仇，而是自我重生.

programme.title: 金宵大厦 Barrack OKarma
programme.desc: 萧伟明陈山聪饰来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex 李施嬅饰容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO李施嬅分饰，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉陈山聪分饰，奇梦还被书店主人林若思张彦博饰写成小说阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘.

programme.title: 洪武三十二 Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆陈山聪，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风谢天华奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣马德钟的得力谋臣马三保陈键锋，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱江若琳却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三徐子珊和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中.

programme.title: 情逆三世缘 Always and Ever
programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.title: 情逆三世缘 Always and Ever
programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲 Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎钱嘉乐受不了母亲刘并蒂黄淑仪不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾陈键锋抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英胡定欣的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘苏玉华制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为王老虎抢亲谱出崭新局面.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 食为奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天宝王祖蓝自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫胡诺言流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪万绮雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女厨神米小鱼何雁诗等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛黄智贤，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭林盛斌，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩张继聪策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗.

programme.title: 坚离地爱坚离地 Offliners, The
programme.desc: 在香港，投身金融地产商业是贴地举动，富二代王子菲龚嘉欣饰却偏爱离地，与好友许正伟陈智燊饰开设初创科技公司一次网络黑客事件让子菲见识到IT奇才丁信希张振朗饰的厉害，邀他加入公司信希是一名离地毒男，不顾世事，得护士张莱刘佩玥饰帮助走出不善沟通的围墙，对她好感渐生；子菲与信希经历分歧，至同心及互补不足，不经意对他产生情愫子菲本相信科技为世界带来美好，但网络风波相继发生在其父王守勤李国麟饰弟王梓龙罗梓龙饰信希之妹丁信恩黄心颖饰身上！.

programme.title: 溏心风暴3 Heart And Greed
programme.desc: 凌丽荧李司棋与丈夫黄永正夏雨凭着努力从茶餐厅发展成为结合地产业务的集团，丽荧弟弟凌乘风黄宗泽更协助他们上市，永正本不欲上市，但因当年许雅麟李国麟助他脱罪之恩，一直耿耿于怀，有见许家经营印刷的百年基业面临倒闭危机，便听从乘风献计，可透过合并令两家相得益彰，但永正的弟妇梁顺华关菊英及亲弟梁赞阮兆祥大力反对，加上与雅麟的太太余秀慧米雪有积怨，对许家自诩上等人印象欠佳，但丽荧力撑丈夫终达成合并协议可惜合并后引发两家一连串的祸端，草根与富豪阶级悬殊激发矛盾丛生，加上二儿子黄围家王浩信与许家独生女许贝儿岑丽香相爱备受阻挠，最终逼使围家远离伤心地，丽荧心痛不已又承受长女黄以爱陈敏之与有妇之夫郑立安唐文龙的丑闻煎熬；就连至疼锡的乘风亦性情大变，与好友方希文黄翠如关系纠缠不清，两家陷入分拆决裂之余更面临一场酝酿已久的复仇风暴.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Wan Su seorang janda, mempunyai anak perempuan bernama Hanim. Dia berkahwin dengan Dato Amri seorang duda mempunyai anak bernama Irma. Bagaimanapun mereka terpisah apabila Wan Su meninggalkan suaminya dan membawa Hanim bersamanya. Kini mereka telah berkeluarga. Irma bersama Luqman dan memiliki sebuah spa kecantikan. Hanim bersama Aizat dan mempunyai seorang anak bernama Tasya. Aizat mempunyai perniagaan Food Truck. Hanim kini bekerja sebagai PA kepada Luqman. Sejak itu penampilan dan sikapnya mula berubah.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Irma berjaya mengesan skandal Luqman dengan Hanim. Irma mahu meninggalkan Luqman. Imbas kembali, 9 tahun lalu semasa di kolej, Irma pernah terpikat dengan Aizat yang kini menjadi suami kepada Hanim. Wan Su datang memujuk Irma yang sedang bersedih. Irma memerlukan masa. Jerry sanggup mengeluarkan modal bagi Aizat memperkembangkan perniagaan Food Truck mereka. Di rumah, Hanim bergaduh besar dengan Aizat, dia menyalahkan Aizat kerana tidak mampu memberinya kemewahan. Hanim meninggalkan rumah.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Luqman berjaya memujuk isterinya semula. Hanim meninggalkan rumah. Tasya sedih kerana mamanya pergi begitu saja. Hanim mendesak Aizat segera menceraikannya. Aizat sedih kerana dia masih sayangkan isterinya itu. Hanim bermalam dengan Luqman yang masih bersikap buaya. Wan Su cuba memikat semula bekas suaminya. Irma mengupah orang untuk mengekori suaminya. Irma mengikut jejak Luqman ke hotel dan dia amat terkejut apabila mendapati suaminya sedang bersama dengan kakak kesayangannya Hanim.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Hanim pandai membuat cerita, kononnya Luqman membantunya tinggal di hotel tersebut selepas Aizat menceraikannya. Irma percaya dengan cerita tersebut. Wan Su tidak sukakan Aizat kerana dari keluarga yang miskin. Irma singgah makan di rumah Wan Su, Wan Su asyik menghina Aizat yang dikatakan miskin berbanding dengan Luqman. Satu hari, Irma berjumpa dengan Aizat, Aizat dikatakan memukul Hanim. Irma marahkan Aizat sehingga mahu menceraikan Hanim. Irma mengajak kakaknya tinggal bersama-sama dengannya sementara mendapat rumah baru.

programme.desc: Zein pulang ke pejabat dan minta maaf dengan Ziyan. Ziyan pada mulanya mengamuk satu pejabat sebab Zein tidak muncul di majlis pelancaran album artis. Encik Haikal terpaksa mengekalkan Zein kerana tidak mahu kehilangan Ziyan, seorang wartawan yang bagus. Namun akhirnya Ziyan terperanjat apabila melihat banyak gambar Nilla di dalam kamera Zein!

programme.desc: Kisah ahli perniagaan London yang rendah hati Quan, yang masa lalunya yang telah lama terkubur meletus dalam dendam yang didorong oleh dendam apabila satu-satunya orang yang ditinggalkan untuk dicintainya - anak perempuan remajanya - diambil daripadanya dalam tindakan keganasan bermotif politik yang tidak masuk akal . Dalam pencarian tanpa henti untuk identiti pengganas, Quan terpaksa terlibat dalam konflik kucing-dan-tikus dengan seorang pegawai kerajaan Ireland, yang masa lalunya mungkin mengandungi petunjuk tentang identiti pembunuh yang sukar difahami.

programme.desc: Memaparkan Lisa marahkan Syamil yang datang ke rumah Mbah Nira untuk berjumpanya. Syamil syak kumpulan lelaki yang meminta pertolongannya adalah perogol. Afifa meminta Lisa menghapuskan SakaSara. Mbah Nira marahkan mereka, namun selepas diketahui Sara adalah mangsa rogol dia merelakannya. Azhar dan Cairyl berpindah tinggal di hotel selepas diganggu oleh lembaga misteri yang kononnya dihantar oleh Mbah Nira semasa mereka berada di rumah Bakri. Nasrun insaf dan bersedia membongkar rahsia Kumpulan Hunter yang merogol gadis penduduk di kampungnya. Nasrun berjumpa dengan Syamil, dia bersedia memberi bukti bagi membantu Syamil menangkap Azhar dan Caryl. Manakala Lisa dan Afifa lebih berminat untuk membalas dendam secara sihir sebelum pihak berkuasa menangkap perogol mereka.

Atas desakan, Ritz menjelaskan peristiwa silam yang menyebabkan bapanya terbunuh dan nyawa Alia terancam.Sementara itu Zack sedih melihat keadaan bapanya yang koma angkara perbuatan datuknya sendiri.Dia bertekad untuk melaporkan perbuatan datuknya selama ini kepada pihak polis. Tengku Fateh, sepupu Zacky, membantu dengan memberi maklumat serta bukti. Mereka sependapat tidak mahu ikut cara bapa-bapa dan datuk mereka menguruskan perniagaan keluarga.Dalam perjalanan pulang Alia diculik oleh sekumpulan lelaki bertopeng. Adam diserang ketika memeriksa kereta Alia yang tersadai disebatang jalan. Ritz yang tidak tahu tentang kejadian resah menunggu kepulangan Alia.

programme.desc: Pada suatu hari, Farhan mengajak 3 sahabatnya bermain sorok-sorok untuk mengingati nostalgia mereka semasa kanak-kanak. Tujuan Farhan sebenarnya adalah untuk mencari Wan Peah. Tiba-tiba, muncul Wan Peah di hadapan Farhan dan bercakap dengannya, Farhan dapat merasakan Wan Peah sebenarnya manusia biasa bukannya hantu. Oleh itu, Farhan berjanji akan membuktikan Wan Peah adalah manusia. Dia menyuarakan rasa cinta kepada Cikgu Siti.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP14
programme.desc: Cikgu Zaiton dapatkan khidmat bomoh untuk memikat Farhan. Semasa mahu menanam tangkai guna-guna di bawah rumah Tok Hashim dia terlanggar dengan Tok Hashim menyebabkan lelaki tersebut retak pinggang. Yeh Kumbang masih cintakan Nurin walaupun Cikgu Siti keberatan untuk melepaskan adiknya untuk berkahwin dengan Yeh Kumbang. Pada suatu malam, Cikgu Siti dan Aisha turun ke bilik air, mereka terkejut berjumpa dengan Wan Peah yang masih hidup. Wan Peah memberi kepada mereka ikan masin yang menjadi kegemaran Aisha. Ini menyebabkan keluarga Cikgu Siti percaya Wan Peah masih hidup.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP15
programme.desc: Li membawa bomoh dan memulakan upacara memanggil hantu Wan Peah. Bomoh ini menggunakan ikan masin untuk memanggil lembaga Wan Peah keluar. Selepas terhidu bau ikan kering yang sangat kuat, ternyata Wan Peah muncul pergi mendapatkannya. Sebaik sahaja ternampak kelibat Wan Peah, Li, Ghani dan Yeh melarikan diri. Melihat aksi Wan Peah, bomoh terus pengsan. Oleh kerana cerita Wan Peah yang tiada penghujungnya, Cikgu Siti merancang untuk berpindah dari situ. Nurin enggan berpindah kerana dia sudah selesa dan jauh disudut hatinya tidak mahu berpisah dengan Yeh.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP16
programme.desc: Bomoh mula memulakan upacara memanggil hantu Wan Peah. Pada ketika itu, Wan Peah sedang berehat di dalam rumah. Selepas terhidu bau ikan kering yang sangat kuat, dia terjaga dan terus mendapatkannya. Pintu rumah Wan Peah dibuka dan dia mula mengutip ikan-ikan kering yang tersusun hingga ke dalam hutan. Sebaik ternampak kelibat Wan Peah, bomoh memulakan membaca jampi mentera kononnya untuk menghalau roh jahat. Li, Ghani, Yeh, Cik Siti dan Aziz hanya melihat sahaja Wan Peah yang memandang pelik kearah mereka. Wan Peah menggeleng kepala langsung kembali pulang ke rumahnya.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP12
programme.desc: Ritz semakin gelisah kerana Alia masih tidak pulang ke rumah. Dalam keadaan panik dia menghubungi Zacky dan secara tidak langsung mendedahkan identiti Alia. Adam yang diserang pengikut Amir diikat dan ditahan dalam sebuah pondok bersama Alia. Pihak polis tiba namun Amir sempat lari dengan mengheret Alia bersamanya. Adam berjaya menjejaki mereka dan menyelamatkan Alia setelah Amir terbunuh dalam pertarungan. Sementara itu, Zacky lega apabila bapanya menunjukkan tanda-tanda pulih. Dalam masa yang sama dia mengesyaki Sophie merancang sesuatu yang buruk. Rafeeq pula tidak dapat mengawal perasaan setelah mengetahui Affiyah masih hidup. Dibertekad untuk membunuh Affiyah dan Ritz.

programme.desc: Terkesan dengan tingkah laku Bahadom terhadapnya di khalayak ramai, Jalil membuat keputusan untuk berhenti bekerja. Dalam satu kemalangan, Datin Sharifah telah berkenalan dengan Jefri, seorang penyanyi kelab malam. Hubungan mereka kemudiannya menjadi semakin intim. Dalam masa yang sama, Ina pula jatuh cinta dengan Jefri.

programme.desc: Ameera yang baru berpindah dari Sabah ke Kuala Lumpur bersekolah di kolej swasta, dan dipilih sebagai ketua kelas. Rakan-rakan Daniel bagaimanapun merasakan bahawa Daniel, sebagai ahli sukan kolej, lebih layak untuk jawatan itu. Ketidakpuasan hati ini memecahkan kelas kepada dua puak. Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Apabila Ameera mengetahui tentang pertaruhan itu, dia dan Daniel menjadi musuh, walaupun telah membina perasaan bersama antara satu sama lain.

Walaupun sering bergaduh dan tidak sehaluan, mereka terpaksa bekerjasama untuk menyelesaikan masalah yang membawa mereka ke dalam dunia penuh aksi, kekacauan dan komedi yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: Dilan 1990
programme.desc: Cerita cinta remaja antara Dilan, seorang pelajar yang unik dan romantik, dengan Milea, pelajar baru yang berpindah ke Bandung pada tahun 1990. Cara Dilan yang berbeza dalam mendekati Milea membuatkan hubungan mereka berkembang, tetapi mereka juga perlu menghadapi cabaran persahabatan, sekolah dan kehidupan remaja.

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Stepmom
programme.desc: Jackie, ibu tiri baru, cuba menyesuaikan diri dengan anak-anak dan hubungan dengan ibu kandung mereka, Isabel. Ketegangan, emosi, dan kasih sayang diuji ketika mereka belajar menerima perubahan dalam keluarga dan menghargai satu sama lain.

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Bopeng
programme.desc: Bo Nabil Ahmad dan Peng Johan Asari ialah dua sahabat baik yang bekerja di Opiel Secret Pizza. Kehidupan mereka berubah apabila pelanggan tetap, Mira Idora Senrose, menelefon meminta tolong selepas diikuti dan diculik seorang lelaki misteri. Menggunakan kepintaran dan pengalaman membaca novel jenayah, Peng memberi arahan kepada Mira untuk menyelamatkan diri dari but kereta. Bersama Bo dan bantuan pihak polis, mereka menjejaki Mira melalui petunjuk unik seperti cat di jalan raya. Namun, musuh yang bijak sentiasa selangkah di hadapan, menjadikan misi menyelamatkan Mira penuh cabaran dan tegang.

programme.title: Ketika Cinta Bertasbih
programme.desc: Cerita tentang Azzam, seorang pemuda yang berpegang teguh pada nilai-nilai Islam, berusaha menuntut ilmu sambil mengekalkan cinta kepada Tsuraya. Mereka menghadapi pelbagai ujian, konflik keluarga, dan rintangan sosial, namun keyakinan dan keimanan membimbing mereka menempuh cabaran cinta dan kehidupan.

programme.title: Ketika Cinta Bertasbih
programme.desc: Cerita tentang Azzam, seorang pemuda yang berpegang teguh pada nilai-nilai Islam, berusaha menuntut ilmu sambil mengekalkan cinta kepada Tsuraya. Mereka menghadapi pelbagai ujian, konflik keluarga, dan rintangan sosial, namun keyakinan dan keimanan membimbing mereka menempuh cabaran cinta dan kehidupan.

programme.title: Ketika Cinta Bertasbih 2
programme.desc: Lanjutan dari Ketika Cinta Bertasbih yang mengisahkan Azzam kembali ke Indonesia selepas 9 tahun belajar di Kairo. Walaupun sudah bergelar sarjana, dia sukar cari kerja dan dipengaruhi tekanan masyarakat. Sambil menambah pengalaman berniaga, Azzam juga berdepan konflik cinta apabila wanita yang dicintainya telah dipinang sahabatnya, sementara Eliana yang menyukainya sendiri belum dapat diterimanya sebagai pilihan hati.

programme.title: Air Mata Terakhir Bunda
programme.desc: Seorang ibu berkorban demi anak-anaknya walaupun terpaksa menghadapi penderitaan dan perpisahan yang menyayat hati.

programme.title: Memory Lane
programme.desc: Kisah pasangan warga emas, Jaap dan Maartje, yang mengembara ke Sepanyol untuk bertemu sahabat lama. Perjalanan tersebut membuka kembali kenangan lama serta membantu mereka menemukan semula makna cinta dan hubungan mereka selepas bertahun bersama.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Zharfa
programme.desc: Filem ini mengisahkan Zharfa, seorang gadis Malaysia yang penuh pemberontakan dan emosional, sejak ditinggalkan oleh ayah kandungnya ketika berusia satu tahun. Selepas ibunya berkahwin dengan lelaki licik, konflik antara Zharfa dan bapa tirinya semakin memuncak. Akhirnya, dia dihantar ke sebuah pesantren di pedalaman Jawa Barat, Indonesia, di mana wataknya terus berkembang dalam latar budaya dan agama yang kuat

programme.title: Prebet Sapu
programme.desc: Pada 2018, Aman berpindah dari Pahang ke Kuala Lumpur mengejar impian menjadi penulis, namun hidupnya penuh kesusahandihalau dari bilik sewa, terpaksa tidur di kereta, dan menjadi pemandu e-hailing secara haram kerana buta warna. Hidupnya berubah apabila bertemu Bella, seorang penumpang yang menawarkan tempat tinggal dengan syarat Aman menjadi pemandu peribadinya. Persahabatan terjalin, tetapi konflik menanti. Bagaimana nasib kedua-dua jiwa miskin bandar ini akan terungkai?

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: Surat Kecil Untuk Tuhan
programme.desc: Kisah dua beradik yatim piatu, Anton dan Angel, yang terpisah selepas kemalangan ketika hidup dalam sindiket pengemis jalanan. Bertahun kemudian, Angel yang telah berjaya sebagai peguam kembali ke Jakarta untuk mencari semula abangnya yang hilang.

programme.title: KIL
programme.desc: Akil, seorang pemuda yang bergelut dengan kemurungan, berkali-kali gagal membunuh diri. Hidupnya berubah apabila dia secara tidak sengaja menyelamatkan seorang gadis yang cuba terjun kerana putus cinta. Suatu hari, dia menemui risalah menawarkan khidmat bunuh diri dan menghubungi Salina, yang membawanya kepada sebuah agensi misteri bernama Life Action Bureau LAB. Di bawah bimbingan konsultan LAB, Encik Harun, Akil mengupah mereka untuk membunuhnya namun dengan syarat dia tidak akan tahu siapa pembunuhnya, bila, atau bagaimana dia akan menemui ajalnya. Segala-galanya kini menjadi permainan maut yang penuh teka-teki.

programme.desc: Persahabatan antara dua orang gadis, Pelangi dan Nirmala. Namun, persahabatan mereka ditentang oleh orang tua mereka kerana perbezaan strata sosial. Pelangi hidup dengan sederhana, sementara Nirmala hidup mewah.

programme.title: Saleha
programme.desc: Saleha mengisahkan seorang gadis baik hati yang ditinggalkan oleh ayahnya dan dibesarkan oleh nenek. Selepas diculik dan kehilangan neneknya, dia dipersalahkan dan dihalau oleh keluarganya. Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

programme.title: Cosplay Deket Kamu Cintanya No Play Play
programme.desc: Rana, seorang gadis berdikari yang bekerja sebagai cosplay hantu di sebuat tempat hiburan untuk memenuhi keperluan hidup dan membayar hutang kakaknya. Suatu hari, Rana bertemu dengan anak saudara bosnya, Ezra, yang ingat Rana ingin menculiknya. Kejadian ini telah membawa hubungan mereka lebih akrab. Namun, hubungan mereka diuji oleh pandangan negatif Ibunya terhadap pekerjaan Rana sebagai cosplayer hantu.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Cinta Setelah Cinta
programme.desc: Starla menyangka dia telah menghadapi segalanya, tetapi penipuan Niko jauh lebih mendalam daripada yang disangkanya. Ketika dia terus berusaha mempertahankan perkahwinannya, ancaman baharu muncul. Ayu, yang masih taksub dengan Niko, semakin mengikatnya dalam perangkap dengan menggunakan anak mereka yang belum lahir sebagai umpan. Pada masa yang sama, naluri Starla merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena, dan dia mula diburu oleh bayang-bayang serta rahsia gelap. Dengan keluarganya di ambang bahaya dan emosinya semakin tertekan, adakah Starla mampu melindungi orang-orang tersayang? Atau adakah pengkhianatan Niko akan mendorongnya melangkaui batas yang tidak boleh kembali?

Pada masa yang sama, naluri Starla merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena, dan dia mula diburu oleh bayang-bayang serta rahsia gelap. Dengan keluarganya di ambang bahaya dan emosinya semakin tertekan, adakah Starla mampu melindungi orang-orang tersayang? Atau adakah pengkhianatan Niko akan mendorongnya melangkaui batas yang tidak boleh kembali?

programme.title: Hi Guys
programme.desc: Sebuah siri separa dokumentari yang menyeronokkan dan dikendalikan oleh sekumpulan hos cilik yang penuh tenaga. Mereka meneroka pelbagai tempat menarik dan aktiviti yang mengujakan, sambil berkongsi pengalaman dengan semangat ingin tahu dan keceriaan. Setiap episod membawa penonton mengikuti perjalanan yang dipenuhi tawa dan penemuan baharu, sambil menggalakkan kanak-kanak untuk belajar serta mengenali dunia di sekeliling mereka dengan cara yang menyeronokkan dan menarik.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Forgotten Valley, The
programme.desc: Highly influenced by western culture, couple LUK SHUI-FUNG Raymond Wong and LAW KWAI-SZE Grace Chan want to reshape their feudal hometown, Ping On Valley, which has fallen so far behind, but nothing comes out as they wish. Not only are they under the tyrannical dictatorship of their father, Village Chief LUK KAM-KUK Lau Kong, who constantly stands in their way, but they are also involved in the ghost bride murder mystery, kidnapping and homicide respectively. Victims of bullying including KAM-KUKs concubines SUNG MING-FUNG Louisa So and KOO MAN-YEE Rebecca Zhu, and maid TIN CHOR-YAT Katy Kung eventually cant take it anymore. Defying the status quo in the fight for gender equality, they secretly form an alliance to protect other girls who fall victim to this. Unexpectedly, a group of wicked guys headed by butler NG SHEUNG-SHUN Louis Yuen bring in bandits for their own selfish motives. While blowing the girls cover, it also puts the relationship of SHUI-FUNG and KWAI-SZE to the test, escalating the feud between men and women

programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Scam Alert!
programme.desc: The number of various scams continues to rise, with the amounts involved becoming increasingly staggering. It is reported that Hong Kong suffers an average daily loss of HK25 million, with a scam occurring every 13 minutes Scams targeting online shopping, job seeking, investment, dating apps, and telephone scams are becoming increasingly sophisticated. Citizens must raise their awareness of scams and be vigilant to avoid falling victim! Hosts Au Wing-Kuen, Edwin Siu, Lee Man-Fong, and Leung Man-Hau gather various real-life cases to gain a deeper understanding of how victims were scammed. The program will also recreate these scenarios in story form. Experts will appear to dissect different methods of committing these crimes, helping viewers identify money-grabbing traps and avoid becoming targets of scammers!

programme.title: ChatSAT
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. By discussing everything under the sun and chatting about the hottest topics, Group friend listeners can easily stay up to date with global trends by following the program.

programme.title: Midlife, Sing Shine! 4
programme.desc: Midlife, Sing Shine! 4 has officially launched, continuing the success of the previous three seasons and once again providing a stage for singing enthusiasts to pursue their dreams. This season expands its recruitment efforts to North America and Australia, with several TVB artists participating masked, igniting the flame of music globally and illuminating the hearts of countless dreamers. Stephanie Che continues to host, offering her warm smile to the contestants Maria Cordero, Chow Kwok-fung, Cheung Ka-tim, Hai-er, and Gu Ya-wei also serve as judges, providing professional feedback and encouragement to the participants. On this new seasons stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of Midlife, Sing Shine! 4.

programme.title: The Joy Of Nature
programme.desc: Taiwans camping destinations are breathtaking! Hong Kong host Lin Yinghui, along with three of Taiwans goddesses Lin Xiang, Zhang Yahan, and Huang Shangyan, embarked on a nature-themed healing trip. They traversed Nantou, Kaohsiung, Taoyuan, and other locations, delving into the Miaoli mountains, trying out forest cabins, luxury campervans, deluxe tents, and even camping at a baseball stadium Surrounded by mountains, they enjoyed open-air hot springs, watched the sunset at the beach, explored historical sites near the campsites, and immersed themselves in nature. Finally, they returned to Yangmingshan in Taipei for camping, soaking in hot springs, and overlooking the unparalleled night view of Taipei! Besides experiencing the unique atmosphere of camping, what sparks will fly between the Taiwanese and Hong Kong women as they interact and bond?

programme.title: Forgotten Valley, The
programme.desc: Highly influenced by western culture, couple LUK SHUI-FUNG Raymond Wong and LAW KWAI-SZE Grace Chan want to reshape their feudal hometown, Ping On Valley, which has fallen so far behind, but nothing comes out as they wish. Not only are they under the tyrannical dictatorship of their father, Village Chief LUK KAM-KUK Lau Kong, who constantly stands in their way, but they are also involved in the ghost bride murder mystery, kidnapping and homicide respectively. Victims of bullying including KAM-KUKs concubines SUNG MING-FUNG Louisa So and KOO MAN-YEE Rebecca Zhu, and maid TIN CHOR-YAT Katy Kung eventually cant take it anymore. Defying the status quo in the fight for gender equality, they secretly form an alliance to protect other girls who fall victim to this. Unexpectedly, a group of wicked guys headed by butler NG SHEUNG-SHUN Louis Yuen bring in bandits for their own selfish motives. While blowing the girls cover, it also puts the relationship of SHUI-FUNG and KWAI-SZE to the test, escalating the feud between men and women

programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: Wangs odd behaviour and quirky ideas make him a social outcast. His teenage nephew Zhou, who is ashamed of his stutter, becomes Wangs only friend. Together, these misfits challenge traditional family expectations and social misunderstandings, supporting and inspiring each other as they seek their own paths in life.

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, a white woman is murdered in Chinatown, and a Chinese man becomes the prime suspect. The crime sparks public outcry to shut down the district. Amid growing unrest, two Chinese detectives, Qin Fu and Ah Gui, race against time to uncover the true killer before prejudice and danger consume their community.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: As the police sets to arrest a drug lord, a team of masked thugs steals the drugs and murders the cops. Inspector Bong is devastated to see the aftermath of the carnage and soon discovers that the killers are led by Ngo, a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him. As the two men meet again, it is time to settle the score

programme.title: CJ7
programme.desc: Stephen Chow returns in this hilarious and heartwarming tale of a father and son who discover an adorable alien in the trash.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma takes on a perilous escort mission across the desert to Changan. His charge is the empires most wanted man, drawing pursuit from all sides. As rival forces close in, Dao Ma is pulled into a conspiracy that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Set 500 years before the Monkey King Wu Kong wreaks havoc in the heavenly kingdom, the movie tells the story of how Wu Kong who, unwilling to bow to his own destiny, sets out to rebel against the gods.

programme.title: Article 20
programme.desc: Han Ming, a prosecutor, faces a whirlwind of complications in his work and family lives: his sons clash with another student in school and his wifes intervention, as well as the strained partnerships at work. Amidst it all, a critical case challenges his sense of righteousness, and he decides to gamble everything to seek fairness and justice.

programme.title: Death Notice
programme.desc: A serial killer leaves death notices in a city, stating when, how and who he will murder. Even if the victims report it to the police and receive protection, the killer can still break through and execute them. While the police sets up a special task force in response, they expose an even bigger conspiracy behind.

programme.title: Lost Love
programme.desc: Mei tries to get over the death of her young son by becoming a foster parent. For 13 years, Meis dedication to the foster child leads her to neglect her husband and the true needs of the child. It is only through the childs unintentional help that the couple finally manages to salvage their relationship.

programme.title: Fox Hunt
programme.desc: Adapted from true events, Fraudster Dai swindled countless victims across China before vanishing without a trace. Seven years later, he resurfaces in Paris. Led by Detective Ye Jun, the Chinese Fox Hunt Team launches a high-stakes cross-border mission to recover the stolen assets and uncovers shocking secrets during the pursuit.

programme.title: Rob N Roll
programme.desc: A ruthless bandit, Tian, has plotted an intense and quick armed robbery. When he encounters Hui and Shui who also plan for a robbery, they decide to team up for the heist. However, their ad-hoc and dramatic robbery has started a war with the police hot on pursuit, putting their lives on the line!

programme.title: Ne Zha 2
programme.desc: After surviving the Heavenly Lightning Strike, the souls of Ne Zha and Ao Bing persist, but their mortal forms lie in ruins. Master Tai Yi seeks to restore them using the Seven-Colored Lotus, yet countless perils loom over the process. As enemies close in and fate hangs in the balance, can they reclaim their bodies and rewrite their destiny?

programme.title: OMG! Moms Big News
programme.desc: 53-year-old Rita and her husband are planning retirement when she discovers shes unexpectedly pregnant, upending their quiet family life. As they prepare for the baby amid chaos and laughter, they learn profound lessons in love and acceptance. Just as peace returns, Rita learns the fetus may have Down syndrome, confronting her with the ultimate crossroads

programme.title: Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: Negotiator Wai becomes the prime suspect in a police murder case. He takes hostages at the police station and demands to negotiate with former negotiator Jun. As the two engage in a high-stake battle of wits, their expertise in psychological manipulation leads to a tense verbal sparring match, gradually shifting their positions and mind sets.

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story
programme.desc: Coba is forced to work at home during COVID-19 and fights with his family every day. He decides to turn his mothers chilli sauce into a trendy commodity to keep his family occupied. With his mother, father and aunt making the chilli sauce together, the family sells it online and the business grows beyond their imagination.

programme.title: Dust To Dust
programme.desc: Back in 1995, the Police successfully arrested five armed bank robbers while the two masterminds got tipped off and made a clean escape. Decades later, retired cop Wang Shou Yue is drawn back to the unsolved case when he sees a blurred figure in a news clip. A battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: True Love For Once in My Life
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered after his affair destroys their marriage, leaving her heartbroken. Years later, when Andrew is diagnosed with cancer, Sabrina chooses to return and care for her former husband despite the pain of the past. As old emotions resurface, she still believes true love comes only once in a lifetime.

programme.title: Life Must Go On
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at funding risk, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match and save it. With an ex-star athlete John as the coach, the girls realize they must face their problems and overcome their challenges instead of dodging them. Can they finally win the match?

programme.title: The Kid From The Big Apple
programme.desc: Raised in the bustle of New York, Sarah is sent to Malaysia to live with her grandfather due to her mothers work. To her, it feels like falling into an unfamiliar world. In a strange neighbourhood, she hides her loneliness behind a guarded, superior attitude. Over time, however, grandfather and granddaughter grow closer, gradually opening their hearts to each other.

programme.title: The White Storm 3 Heaven Or Hell
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Billy works undercover in Suchats drug cartel, while another undercover cop Wing successfully earns their trust in an incident and a brotherly bond is built among the three. When the police busts the syndicate, Suchat flees to the Golden Triangle with Billy and receives a tip-off about the betrayal within his circle of trust

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Los brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hus house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hus pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywoods famous Beach Party movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas pursuit.

programme.title: The Comedy Of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sisters wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh Glass Tears, Killer Clans and Shi Szu Lovers Destiny, who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they cant escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Love Without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zangs journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sings wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her masters family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a polices son, blames his father for his mothers death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: The story is about the legendary Monkey King Liu Chung-chun teams up with Goddess of Mercy Chao Li-chuan and the Dragon Girl Lung Nu to battle the child god Hung Hai-erh Ting Hua-chung,son of the Ox Demon Hung Hai-erh to rescue Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim Teng Chio-jen.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: That Fiery Girl
programme.desc: The bandits of Hulu Valley slay the chief of the Mei Clan while searching for a treasure map. In retaliation, Chun from the Mei Clan infiltrates the bandits fortress to map a way in for the authorities, but ends up falling in love with the bandit leaders daughter, Pearl. While Chuns plot is uncovered, he receives unexpected help from Pearl.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the Tsai Li Fu style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Lohs looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet Classic Beauty.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yens family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the Embroidery Bandit starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: Theres no place like home.

programme.title: Puppy
programme.desc: The life of a college student changes when he finds out that his girlfriend is pregnant. He tries to find a way to communicate the news to his family.

programme.title: Gully Rowdy
programme.desc: A young man tries to find a balance between his love interest and friends. Meanwhile, his friends convince him to stay rowdy.

programme.title: Velan
programme.desc: Velan offends his powerful father Palanisamy with his privileged ways, angering the village patriarch. He falls for Ananya, a Malayali college mate, complicating loyalties and love.

programme.title: Masooda
programme.desc: A single mother Neelam and her daughter Nazia face horror as an evil force intrudes. With help from neighbor Gopi, they confront danger and persevere.

programme.title: Vellakara Durai
programme.desc: Two friends, Pandi and Murugan, borrow money from Vatti Varadhan to invest in real estate, but their plans fail when a land broker cheats them by selling a burial ground.

programme.title: Samar
programme.desc: Shankar and Roopa fall in love with each other but she suddenly ends their relationship and moves out of the country. Shankar receives a mysterious invitation from Roopa to come to Bangkok.

programme.title: CBI 5
programme.desc: After a series of murders take place one after another, a police officer decides to investigate the case himself and bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: Wolf
programme.desc: Sanjay surprises his fiancee with an unannounced visit, only to find her displeased. When a sudden lockdown traps him, he discovers her true nature.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Lakshmi
programme.desc: Lakshmi dreams of winning a national level dance competition but is scared to participate as her mother despises dancing. However, things take a turn when she meets Krishna, a cafe owner.

programme.title: Veeran
programme.desc: A 15-year-old boy living in Veeranor, gets struck by lightning and goes into a short coma. After recovery, he gradually realizes that he has superpowers of lightning and mind control.

programme.title: Irumbu Thirai
programme.desc: A military officer borrows money for his sisters marriage using fake papers. When the money goes missing from his account, he embarks on an investigation that uncovers a hacker.

programme.title: Sirai
programme.desc: Police officer Kathiravan must escort a prisoner from Vellore to Sivagangai court. Along the long road, unexpected encounters force both men to question everything they know.

programme.title: Kho Kho
programme.desc: Maria, a physical education teacher, takes up the chance to train the schools promising girls team in the sport of kho-kho. While doing so, she aspires to accomplish her own unfulfilled dream.

programme.title: Kadaisi Nodigal
programme.desc: When a serial killer goes on a murder spree, Samuel, a forensic expert, uses his skills to find evidence and uncover the killers identity.

programme.title: Kanaa
programme.desc: Kousalya, a farmers daughter, dreams of becoming an international cricketer and winning the World Cup. With her fathers support, she faces numerous challenges in her pursuit.

programme.title: Asvins
programme.desc: A bunch of YouTubers accidentally unleash a 1500-year-old evil from the dark realm, causing chaos in the human world. Now, they must band together to stop it!

programme.desc: Get up to speed on critical news and events in Hong Kong and around the rest of the world. We give our viewers insight on the stories that matter the most, ranging from business to breaking news, key events, as well as all the latest sporting action, twice daily.

programme.title: 趣遊新西蘭
programme.desc: In this new series This Tastes Funny, Iliza and her chef husband Noah are travelling the length of New Zealand - one stop before the middle of nowhere. Confined to a small motorhome and only each other for company - they are here to discover the sights, tastes, and weirdly the smells that this country has to offer. All in preparation for Ilizas first New Zealand comedy show, because - if youre going to make fun of an entire country, you must first understand every gritty detail.

programme.title: 狙魔人
programme.desc: Superstar Hugh Jackman is Van Helsing, the fabled 19th century monster hunter who travels to distant and dangerous lands on his quest to vanquish evil. He must battle classic villains Dracula, Frankensteins monster, and the Wolf Man-all of whom return to the silver screen for this epic and dark horror adventure. The ravishing Kate Beckinsale joins Jackman in his crusade against darkness, while the modern master of horror Stephen Sommers astutely directs with an affection for the classic horror films of the 1920s and 30s.

programme.title: ViuTV News

programme.title: 夢想家居大改造 澳洲篇
programme.desc: Dream Home is set to take the renovation genre to new heights as six pairs of everyday Aussies battle it out room by room, transforming tired suburban family homes into astonishing new dream homes.

programme.title: 超凡餅藝家
programme.desc: The Big Bake is a larger-than-life baking competition series with themed episodes. In each episode, three professional baking teams have five hours to design, bake and decorate a grand-scale cake creation based on a particular theme. These bakers need to think big and bold, blowing up their designs to gigantic proportions and thinking outside the bakery box. In the end, the most ambitious, eye-popping and delicious cake will go home with a 10,000 prize.

programme.title: 台灣山步行
programme.desc: 位於南投縣鹿谷鄉的溪頭，是一個三面環山的凹谷地形，海拔在800到2,000公尺之間溪頭中心點有個風景絕美的大學池，這座池子，有個美麗的傳說相傳有一對戀人因受雙方家庭的反對，一路被追趕至此，兩人來到了橋的中央，互相許下誓言，接著便從橋上一踴而下是來到這絕不能錯過的，只是沒想到阿妹第一次來到溪頭，就遇到滂沱大雨，只能在雨中行山位於森林遊樂區入口旁的妖怪村，充滿濃濃的日式建築風味，以松林町商店街為概念去打造，來紀念溪頭當地早期一位山林保育專家松林勝一，走在街上閒逛，還隨處可見奇特造型的妖怪塑像，而且一不小心，還會被街上的妖怪抓住，一起去跳舞歡樂的氣氛也讓這成為南投近年來最熱門的景點

programme.title: 終於飛到LA
programme.desc: 下雨天的洛杉磯有甚麼好去處？阿妹和 Jessica 放慢腳步，品嚐西式和中式美食，亦來到星光大道的中國戲院，不小心從導賞團離隊的兩人有甚麼有趣的發現？接着，她們到蠟像館和逾百個明星蠟像合照，還有還原度極高的經典電影場景，影迷絕對不能錯過！

programme.title: 打開你雪櫃
programme.desc: 小薯茄短片主要以幽默及引起共鳴為主，因此獲得不少支持者截至2021年11月21日，訂閱已超過40萬他們的頻道有不同的系列，其中雪櫃冷笑話最有名，深得觀眾歡心今集小谷一於打開有可能係全香港最多人識嘅雪櫃，教佢哋整最啱工作室生活嘅 Forsen 雞扒，並向小薯茄學做 Youtuber！

programme.title: 舉頭三尺
programme.desc: Kathy仔與YOYO來到新港，任務是學習製作拜佛拜神用的香，香藝文化園區裡老師傅授百年傳承的製香技術，兩位靚女能學會嗎？完成任務終於找到溪口開元殿鄭成功神像開元殿是位於嘉義溪口鄉的鄭成功廟，開元殿最大特色為擁有一座高53公尺號稱世界最高的延平郡王鄭成功神像，旁邊還有兩尊大 神像，分別是他的部屬萬禮甘輝兩位將軍，館內還有珍貴的文 物，是嘉南平原上主要的地標之一

programme.title: 區區都有STEM
programme.desc: 今集，主持Gracey和STEM Sir 前往屯門香港作為高發展城市，吋金尺土，耕作都結合科技，能在城市狹縫中發展，二人在一個購物商場中，觀察以精耕農業發展模式的水耕種植箱Stem Sir 會講解科技如何發展出精確耕種，以至可以在一個有冷氣的室內商場種植之後會觀察現在各大商場及食肆都出現的AI 機械人最後，會觀察停車場的雙層泊車架，如何運用數學的空間計算，節省位置

programme.title: 我要爆Show
programme.desc: 身為Viutv老是常出現的元老級藝員Dixon入行超過10年，雖然一直爆Show，但發展一路平平，一眾本台同事都認為Dixon的代表作已經要追溯到8年前的SE7EN有見及此，製作組悉心安排SE7EN復刻之旅，希望能讓Dixon尋回最初入行，不顧一切的自己！

programme.title: 演奏1 TAKE過
programme.desc: 今集有唯一入選嘅海外演奏家 Rossano，佢吹奏嘅樂器叫上低音號，讀書時期只得佢一人修讀呢件樂器，不過，佢搵到佢最喜歡嘅樂器，同時，亦搵到可以並肩前行嘅另一半一齊行音樂路，甚至行到去英國，再返嚟香港！難得搵到心愛嘅樂器又搵到心愛嘅人，演奏 1 TAKE 過帶大家睇一個純愛嘅音樂故事！

programme.title: 我想身體健康
programme.desc: 腦膜炎雙球菌血清型超多，我們要如何應對？今集主持強尼米露迪Ash，找來Jason一起請教醫生！香港是否處於高危區域，我們要如何防範？

programme.title: CHILL CLUB
programme.desc: 本集嘉賓是Shiga 連詩雅，以其新歌殘忍告別式為主題，Shiga會演繹幾首關於一個女孩子尋找自我的過程，當關係上遇到挫折或者背叛時，我們會選擇如何面對呢？今集讓Shiga和你一起告別那些錯的人此外，節目亦設有 CHILL CLUB 推介榜，與樂迷一同公布本週第一至第十位推介歌曲

programme.title: 地獄廚神是我媽
programme.desc: 今集主角 Eva 媽媽最喜歡買外賣食物加料，原因是想吸引兒子 Daniel 吃不喜歡的食物Eva 媽媽為了想Daniel 吃涼瓜，竟然買快餐店的炸雞塊，然後將炸雞塊加入涼瓜一起煮，更混合其招牌甜酸醬Daniel 形容這是一個甜酸苦辣咸味道都有的菜式除了兒子 Daniel，Connie 作為 Daniel 青梅竹馬的好朋友也忍不住對 Eva 媽媽作出投訴，Eva 媽媽的喳咋溝珍珠奶茶特飲更令 Daniel 和 Connie 從此對珍珠奶茶有陰影今次研究所派出大廚雷啟裕為 Eva 媽媽進行廚藝特訓，希望可以全面改善她的烹調技巧，為她的家庭關係帶來轉機！

programme.title: 潛在挑戰中
programme.desc: 製作組為潛水新星進行潛伴配對，四人於水底尋寶，取得同款信物為一組兩組潛伴舉行結伴儀式，在製作組見證下許下承諾，結伴迎接未來旅程潛水挑戰接踵而來，首要任務需眾人合作，潛入海底獲取證書，考得O牌期間困難重重，Kylie受耳朵傷患憂心落淚，各人力有不逮，海底意外頻生，考牌之路充滿險阻

programme.title: 在絕版前放浪一次
programme.desc: 一輪驚濤駭浪，把娟和Chris帶到獲獎無數的塞舌爾保育小島庫金島，一些一度要成為絕版的物種，在這裡卻和人類極之親近，令兩位驚奇不已他們更再次遇到塞舌爾的國寶級動物，世界第二大的陸龜品種阿達伯拉象龜，和牠一次零距離接觸，感受竟然像整車？接著，娟和Chris展開一次即興行程，跟隨酒店附近餐廳老闆的爸爸出海釣魚，體驗塞舌爾的國民活動這裡水域的魚類有多豐富？最後兩位能成功把新鮮魚帶回餐廳，即捕即食嗎？

programme.title: 跑住玩
programme.desc: 兩位跑手破戒上船，chill住玩御所浦島當地有恐龍島之稱，並非浪得虛名，曾發掘無數史前化石恐龍控Inez嫌博物館齋睇未夠喉，跑到化石挖掘場，一試手氣，她倆竟然滿載而歸？！要喜上加喜，不如浸個溫泉，回復元氣

programme.title: MM730 - 困獸鬥
programme.desc: 今集節目6位主持分成2組，先考驗他們的小學雞常識，沒想到一條人人都聽過的石板街竟然就考起6人去到第2個遊戲玩井字過3關，一向表現過人的洪嘉豪竟然接連失敗，當中發生了甚麼事？

programme.title: 職人小學徒
programme.desc: 一支針一束羊毛，再加一個重重覆覆的動作，竟然就可做出生動的動物可愛的Q版公仔？當然，擁有像羊毛氈藝術家Marsh Wong的那一雙巧手才是關鍵今集主持和小學就會在Marsh老師指導下，針出一個新生命

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 大鳴大放是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界

programme.title: 同鄉同味
programme.desc: 蘇浙滬同鄉會多年來都熱心服務及貢獻社會，開辦學校老人院及診療所，服務市民大眾提起蘇浙滬一帶，當然不得不提及浙江和上海菜，一起來看看有哪幾款正宗的菜式

programme.title: 怪獸8號
programme.desc: 吸收了裝備識別怪獸兵器2號的四之宮功後，怪獸9號獲得了怪獸2號的強大力量儘管在鳴海與卡夫卡的全力進攻下將怪獸9號逼入絕境，卻還是在最後一刻讓其脫逃隨著功的死訊傳出，全日本陷入了深沉哀慟與對未來的不安在如此情勢中，鳴海與奇可露各自在心中做出決定而卡夫卡則將不得不正視自身力量所帶來的代價

programme.title: 摔角魂
programme.desc: 職業摔角是一種以競技方式進行的表演藝術，過程充分展現摔角手在擂台上的拼勁及雄姿仿如真實的擂台格鬥，讓觀眾看得熱血沸騰各個國家的摔角表演，因應當地文化差異而有所不同，亞洲地區以日本摔角發展得最為蓬勃香港及台灣近年也發展得有聲有色，可謂後起之秀香港選手何顥麟更成功衝出亞洲，打到美國，正式成為世界摔角最高殿堂WWE的選手，在美國各地巡迴演出此節目的真正目的是透過香港摔角代表人物何顥麟及其團員，向廣大觀眾介紹，摔角到底是一種什麼表演藝術？如何由一名初哥變成擂台好手？過程以真人騷形式進行，再配以輕鬆搞笑的故事骨幹及旁白，深入淺出地介紹日本與香港之間的摔角文化及特色更會詳盡介紹摔角手鮮為人知的一面，擂台英姿訓練苦況日常生活...等等，務求全方化了解摔角，投入摔角

programme.title: 文藝誌
programme.desc: 作為話劇演員，日常究竟有什麼練習可以訓練？今集主持繼續親身體驗，也了解一下劇團的未來發展

programme.title: 平行教室
programme.desc: 活躍於社交媒體的內容創作者- Killer，以獨特風格和食字題材吸引年輕觀眾擅長捕捉潮流話題，透過影片與互動建立個人品牌，展現網絡世代的影響力與創意

programme.title: 環源基本步
programme.desc: 廢棄陶瓷轉化為有價值的產品？嘉賓以資源取代廢物，推動陶瓷的永續發展Xapa與香港的陶瓷工作室及教育機構合作，收集陶瓷廢料，實施創新的循環回收方法通過精細的處理，將陶瓷廢物轉為可重新製作的原材料，減少陶瓷廢料令重新創造出的新陶瓷產品，美觀且富有意義，展現可持續藝術的未來，並彰顯資源再利用的重要性

programme.title: Dr.Any毛
programme.desc: 當狗狗體能突然下降，可能代表牠們已經患上心臟病! 現場三位嘉賓為了更加了解這個病，向獸醫展現了飢渴的一面當獸醫為現場嘉賓的狗狗做檢查之際，竟然即時指出原來牠們都患病，令奴才們大為緊張

programme.title: 老友記實用手冊
programme.desc: 芬蘭木棋是一項老少咸宜的新興運動，玩法簡單，能有效鍛鍊長者的手眼協調，更是擴闊社交圈子的絕佳橋樑有長者中心特意引入芬蘭木棋，本集邀請活動負責人，解構這項運動的特色與規則，亦邀請長者分享學習木棋的原因，助銀髮族透過趣味競技，輕鬆重拾活力

programme.title: 雙線運動人生
programme.desc: ICE，壺鈴運動員，作為健身室負責人與運動員的雙重身份，用實際行動推動壺鈴運動普及，也證明管理與競技可以並行不悖壺鈴運動講求力量爆發力與核心穩定，在香港屬逐漸興起的功能性訓練項目ICE 多年來堅持系統訓練，積極參與本地及亞洲壺鈴賽事，以紮實技術與強悍體能成為圈中代表人物

programme.title: 運動員背後
programme.desc: 怎樣做到一個好隨隊物理治療師？只要跟隨指定程序為球員處理傷患就合格？今集標準流浪隨隊物理治療師 Kevin 用行動解釋，什麼是一個標準隨隊物理治療師由細微地方着眼，以球員角度出發，只要你以誠待人，球員都會感受到你的用心

programme.title: 學神出沒注意
programme.desc: 今集學神出沒注意P牌女神誓要大復仇，一洗撞車污名！節目組為嘉倩特意準備了外賣妹大考驗：揸車到九龍城買外賣再送去荃灣目的地，途中驚險百出，更差點在龍翔道與大貨車相撞！第二個大考驗則是勇衝地獄停車場！勤力補鐘後的嘉倩將挑戰香港三大令人聞風喪膽嘅停車場之一，為自己的泊車技巧一雪前恥！

programme.title: 聲畫合拍 9
programme.desc: 全自主49故事講述一名保險業精英在準備與一位重要客戶簽訂大單時，卻在公司驚見另一個自己為免生意被搶，他急忙出手阻止，沒想到更多自己接連現身本集邀請到導演攝影及主演們上來分享拍攝趣事與心得

programme.title: 夜漫遊
programme.desc: 青島又被名為海鮮天堂，為食嘅Anton帶咗Yoshi去食豪華痛風餐，話要一次過試勻晒13款蒸海鮮！青島三面環海嘅環境除咗出名食海鮮，仲孕育咗唔少同海有關嘅故事：章魚精靈美人魚，而明．海間不夜城就將神話故事形象化，有得睇表演之餘仲有得著古裝玩cosplay！

programme.title: 狗仔隊亂入Seoul

programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.desc: 장애나 희귀병으로 고통받는 아이들과, 가난 때문에 치료를 포기 해야만 하는 위기에 처한 가정을 찾아가, 전문의, 심리학자, 상담사, 건축설계사 등 국내 최고의 전문가 그룹이 장애를 앓고 있는 어린이와 그 가정의 회복을 목표로 전문적이고 구체적인 해결 방안을 제시해준다 치료와 재활을 적극적으로 도와주는 솔루션 프로그램.

programme.title: 생활의 달인
programme.desc: 수십년간 한 분야에 종사하며 부단한 열정과 노력으로 달인의 경지에 이르게 된 사람들. 삶의 스토리와 리얼리티가 담겨 있는 생활 달인은 그 자체가 다큐멘터리. 비록 소박한 일이지만 평생을 통해 최고가 된 생활 달인의 놀라운 득도의 경지를 만나는 시간.

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.desc: 어린이들 사이에서 최고의 인기를 자랑하고 있는 바닷속 네모난 친구는 누구일까요? 기상천외하고 유쾌하면서도 매력만점의 주인공 스폰지밥을 만나보세요! 저 깊은 태평양 바닷속, 비키니 씨티라는 해저도시에는 네모낳고 노란 해면동물 스폰지밥과 친구들이 있습니다. 스폰지밥은 애완동물인 달팽이 핑핑이와 함께 파인애플 집에 살고 있습니다. 스폰지밥의 장기는 정말 맛있는 음식을 척척 만들어 내는 멋쟁이 요리사라는 점과 언제나 모든 소동과 사건의 현장에 있다는 것입니다! 괴팍한 이웃 친구 징징이를 괴롭히는 것도 스폰지밥의 또다른 특기죠. 스폰지밥의 단짝 친구는 솔직하고 사랑스러운 불가사리 뚱이, 그리고 스릴만점의 모험을 즐기는 여자친구인 다람이입니다. 꿈과 환상의 도시인 비키니 시티 에서는 물고기 친구들이 걸어다니고, 게살버거가 가장 맛있는 음식은 이라고 하네요. 지금 바로 바닷속에 뛰어들어서 스폰지밥의 매력에 흠뻑 젖어보세요!

programme.title: 네모바지 스폰지밥
programme.desc: 어린이들 사이에서 최고의 인기를 자랑하고 있는 바닷속 네모난 친구는 누구일까요? 기상천외하고 유쾌하면서도 매력만점의 주인공 스폰지밥을 만나보세요! 저 깊은 태평양 바닷속, 비키니 씨티라는 해저도시에는 네모낳고 노란 해면동물 스폰지밥과 친구들이 있습니다. 스폰지밥은 애완동물인 달팽이 핑핑이와 함께 파인애플 집에 살고 있습니다. 스폰지밥의 장기는 정말 맛있는 음식을 척척 만들어 내는 멋쟁이 요리사라는 점과 언제나 모든 소동과 사건의 현장에 있다는 것입니다! 괴팍한 이웃 친구 징징이를 괴롭히는 것도 스폰지밥의 또다른 특기죠. 스폰지밥의 단짝 친구는 솔직하고 사랑스러운 불가사리 뚱이, 그리고 스릴만점의 모험을 즐기는 여자친구인 다람이입니다. 꿈과 환상의 도시인 비키니 시티 에서는 물고기 친구들이 걸어다니고, 게살버거가 가장 맛있는 음식은 이라고 하네요. 지금 바로 바닷속에 뛰어들어서 스폰지밥의 매력에 흠뻑 젖어보세요!

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Bima S
programme.desc: Bima-S adalah sebuah serial animasi superhero Indonesia yang didasarkan pada serial Bima Satria Garuda. Serial ini mulai tayang pada tanggal 4 Oktober 2020 di RCTI, dan dilanjutkan dengan musim kedua yang juga tayang pada 23 Oktober 2022. Bima-S kemudian pindah tayang dari RCTI ke MNC TV di pertengahan penayangan Season 2. Setelah itu, Bima-S juga mulai ditayangkan di Global TV, salah satu kanal TV milik MNC Group.

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Zakstorm
programme.desc: Zak Storm menceritakan petualangan Zak Storm, seorang remaja yang tidak sengaja terhisap ke dalam Segitiga Bermuda saat kompetisi selancar. Di sana, ia menjadi kapten sebuah kapal bajak laut bernama Seven C, dan berteman dengan pedang ajaib bernama Calabrass, yang memungkinkannya berubah menjadi pahlawan pemberani. Bersama krunya yang unik, Zak berlayar mengarungi tujuh lautan di Segitiga Bermuda untuk mencari jalan pulang sambil menghadapi berbagai musuh kuat
